scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter @storytime/web exec vitest run tests && pnpm --filter @storytime/worker exec vitest run src/jobs
scripts.test:e2e:web: node -e "const { scripts = {} } = require('./apps/web/package.json'); const command = scripts['test:e2e']; if (!command || /\becho\b|no .*tests? yet/i.test(command)) { console.error('Web E2E gate is not implemented: replace the placeholder @storytime/web test:e2e script with Playwright.'); process.exit(1); }" && pnpm --filter @storytime/web test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:mobile: node -e "const { scripts = {} } = require('./apps/mobile/package.json'); const command = scripts['test:e2e']; if (!command || /\becho\b|no .*tests? yet/i.test(command)) { console.error('Mobile E2E gate is not implemented: replace the placeholder @storytime/mobile test:e2e script with Maestro.'); process.exit(1); }" && pnpm --filter @storytime/mobile test:e2e
scripts.test:ai: pnpm --filter @storytime/worker exec vitest run src/providers src/jobs/buildStoryRun.test.ts src/jobs/processTurn.test.ts
scripts.test:media: pnpm --filter @storytime/worker exec vitest run src/jobs/processCompositionJob.test.ts src/jobs/processReplayJob.test.ts src/jobs/processTrackOutputJob.test.ts src/jobs/completeReplayJob.test.ts src/jobs/outputPlan.test.ts
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e:web && pnpm test:ai && pnpm test:media && pnpm build
